episodes.title: Los demonios están entre nosotros
episodes.summary: To find a girl who disappeared under mysterious circumstances, a young priest puts his faith in a demon hunter who's known for his unorthodox methods.

episodes.title: Pata de perro, corazón de pollo
episodes.summary: A room reeking of a Type 2 demon leads the team to an underground fight club, where Nancy strikes a deal with the owner. Keta looks for Lucía's body.

episodes.title: Los hijos ocultos
episodes.summary: Keta has history with Isaac -- and she's sure it's tied to the case. Mariana gets to know her protector, a woman who claims she can keep her safe.

episodes.title: Conjuro arcano
episodes.summary: Using Nancy as the vessel and the claw that was stuck in his back, Elvis performs an ancient ritual to summon the demon — with unsettling results.

episodes.title: El cónclave
episodes.summary: A frightened Mariana runs for help, while Elvis seeks wisdom from his father. Keta learns she's much more powerful than she realized.

episodes.title: Una mujer diablera
episodes.summary: Mamá Chabela reveals her plans for the future, and Cardinal Morelo asks Ventura to choose sides. Elvis goes looking for the Diableras.

episodes.title: Cuatro tumbas
episodes.summary: Elvis and his crew race to find Mamá Chabela and the children in time. Elsewhere, a spell has Isaac behaving unlike himself.

episodes.title: Cielo rojo
episodes.summary: When all signs point to the end of the world, the team gathers supplies and prepares to fight back -- or die trying.

episodes.title: Buscando a Ventura
episodes.summary: As a mysterious club owner seeks Elvis's help, a familiar voice sends a message about a door that can't be closed — and the key to keeping it open.

episodes.title: El Ahuizotl
episodes.summary: Elvis, Keta and Nancy cross into the underworld to find Ventura and bring him home. Elsewhere, a much older Mayakén displays disturbing powers.

episodes.title: Lágrimas de demonio
episodes.summary: There's a monster at large — that's certain. But no one is quite sure how to kill it ... or why its victims' bones are as black as night.

episodes.title: La Coatlicue
episodes.summary: The crew sets a trap to catch the monster with Lupe's help — and the last of the LDD. But Death is looking for Elvis while they wait.

episodes.title: Uno no escoge a la familia
episodes.summary: A series of flashbacks to the past reveal what happened to Mayakén, shedding light on his unusual childhood.

episodes.title: La llave negra
episodes.summary: With time running out to protect the portal, Elvis and friends join forces to infiltrate the Conclave — and free Mayakén.
